citation: Album of Genealogy and Biography, Cook County, Illinois, Thomas Franklin McClintock entry.
locator: Thomas McClintock Sr. moved with sons including Thomas Franklin McClintock to Bachelor's Grove, Cook County, in fall 1833
note: Retrospective Cook County biography. The exact surname/given name and 1833 Cook County move create a plausible family-level candidate for Thomas M'Clintock, but both father Thomas and son Thomas Franklin are present, so the postal-list identity cannot be assigned to either individual.
